sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Fight Nikare, then Kenut, then split into two full subgroups (tank/heal/boons each) to finish both together. Both twins fixate the highest-toughness player for their auto-attacks. A 10-stack Waterlogged debuff is an instant kill throughout, so condition cleanse and healing matter the whole fight.

sections.heading: Nikare (100% → 50%)
bullets: Aquatic Detainment (every 23s): a sword slash drops a small orange circle under everyone — brief float + damage.
Geyser (every 10s): large circles launch two random players and stack Waterlogged.
Tidal Pool (every 13s): a random non-tank gets a timed pool that drops an expanding water AoE after 5s — walk it to the platform edge before it lands.
Vapor Rush (every 23s): three dashes — twice at the furthest player, then back to the tank. Hits hard, don't be caught by it.

sections.heading: Kenut (100% → 50%)
bullets: Three water tornadoes sweep clockwise across the platform, applying damage, conditions, and Waterlogged — don't get caught in one.
Vapor Jet (every 20s): teleports to the furthest player and fires a rectangle attack that steals boons.
Sea Swell: a shockwave that launches players and grants Kenut toughness per player hit — spread out for it.
Cyclone Burst: low direct damage, but stacks Waterlogged — don't ignore it just because the hit is small.

sections.heading: Split phase (50% → 25%)
bullets: The squad divides onto left and right platforms, each fighting one Twin with the same mechanics as before, plus Aquatic Barrage — a defiance bar phase where the boss spins and fires water bolts (projectile destruction helps).
You have a 2-minute timer per platform before the arena floods — that's a wipe if missed.

sections.heading: Final phase (25% → 0%)
bullets: Aquatic Aura stacks incoming damage +2% every 3 seconds — push to end the fight rather than let this run long.
Once one Twin dies, the other Enrages for +200% damage — bring both down at roughly even pace rather than favoring one side.
